Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026

Ridgeway Rentals ("we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us when you request a quote, book a trailer, or otherwise contact us through https://ridgewayrentals.ca.

Information We Collect

When you submit a booking request or contact form, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, delivery address, and details about your rental request (such as drop-off/pick-up dates and what you plan to dispose of).

How We Use Your Information

We use the information you provide to confirm trailer availability, schedule delivery and pickup, respond to your inquiries, and communicate with you about your booking. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

Sharing Your Information

We may share your information with staff or contractors involved in fulfilling your rental, or when required to comply with the law. We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

Data Retention

We retain booking and contact information only as long as necessary to fulfill your request, maintain business records, and comply with legal obligations.

Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us using the details below.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at sales@ridgewayrentals.ca or 365-925-0155.
